summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Bob Hess, a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman. It covers his birth details, his National Hockey League teams, and his stints in Switzerland's top league between 1982 and 1984.
one_line: Bob Hess is a retired Canadian ice hockey defenceman who played in the NHL and later in Switzerland's Nationalliga A.
key_facts: Robert George Hess was born on May 19, 1955 in Middleton, Nova Scotia.
Bob Hess is a Canadian retired professional ice hockey defenceman.
Bob Hess played in the National Hockey League for the St. Louis Blues.
Bob Hess played in the National Hockey League for the Buffalo Sabres.
Bob Hess played in the National Hockey League for the Hartford Whalers.
Between 1982 and 1984, Bob Hess played in Switzerland's Nationalliga A.
Bob Hess played for HC Lugano in Switzerland's Nationalliga A.
Bob Hess played for EHC Kloten in Switzerland's Nationalliga A.
